data.long_meaning: The name Valdis is derived from the Old Norse word ‘valr’ which means ruler, and ‘dis’ which means god. This name was traditionally given to those who were believed to possess great wisdom, power, and leadership abilities.

in_greek.name: Βάλντις

in_latin.name: Valdis
